CHAPTER 1 · ITEM 01 / 10

Scarcity, choices and opportunity cost

Scarcity & trade-offs稀缺與取捨

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Explain scarcity, constraints and why choices involve trade-offs. Identify the alternatives forgone in a decision.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

稀缺同時涉及有限資源和人們的需要。預算、時間和能力限制可行選項；做選擇就要放棄其他用途。

Scarcity means available resources cannot satisfy every want. A constraint limits feasible choices. Choosing one use of time or money gives up other possible uses.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：You have 2 hours; studying takes 2 hours and working takes 2 hours. You can do either, but cannot do both. 只有兩小時，讀書和打工各要兩小時，兩者不能同時完成。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

You have $100; two activities each cost $80. What creates the trade-off? 兩項活動各要 $80，取捨來自什麼？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
